source: Fixed official MSE2026 anytime-weighted benchmark archive, preserving the selected 200 formula texts and excluding the declared public-development overlap.

default_reconstruction.source_mapping: Each recipe output declares its unique official member, exact original seed name, seed, canonical and transformed plaintext SHA-256, dimensions and bounded source sizes.
algorithm: Use the declared historical canonical format: original-v1 retains source comments and emits hard clauses before soft clauses; streaming-two-pass-v1 omits source comments, writes its fixed historical prefix and preserves original input clause order.
Original deterministic variable permutation, per-clause literal permutation and final clause ordering, with the same Random call order and historical seed labels.
Fixed XZ5.2.5 preset6, one thread. Selected formulas retain their original canonical and relabeled plaintext identities and per-instance solver budget.

original-v1.description: Original new-to-classic conversion, retaining comments and hard-then-soft order.

streaming-two-pass-v1.description: Historical large-input conversion prefix, without source comments; original input clause order is preserved. Each canonical plaintext SHA remains fixed per output.

original_compressed_version.selection: Historical 211-instance product only; unavailable as a fixed_archive source for the selected final set.

license_basis: Retain the existing MSE source-record attribution and CC-BY-4.0 notice. This change adds no redistribution permission or public image pin.

verification.scope: Selected formula names, canonical and relabeled plaintext SHA-256, seed parameters and compressed payload manifest.
